comparisons.peer_summary: Cash dividends declared on preferred stock were $1.6 billion in each of 2024, 2023, and 2022. In 2024, the Corporation fully redeemed Series X, Series U, Series JJ, and Series Z stock at their liquidation preference values for a total of $5.3 billion.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Bank of America (BAC) disclosed the redemption of multiple series of preferred stock in 2024. GS redeemed Series K and Series P with a total redemption value of $2.2 billion, recording a $34 million impact on dividends. BAC redeemed Series X, U, JJ, and Z with a total value of $5.3 billion. While both firms actively reduced their preferred stock liabilities through redemptions in the same fiscal year, the scale and specific series redeemed differed.

sentences.text: In 2024, the firm redeemed all outstanding shares of its (i) Series K 6.375% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock (Series K Preferred Stock) with a redemption value of $700 million ($25,000 per share), plus accrued and unpaid dividends and (ii) Series P 5.00% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock (Series P Preferred Stock) with a redemption value of $1.50 billion ($25,000 per share), plus accrued and unpaid dividends.
The difference between the redemption value and net carrying value at the time of these redemptions was $34 million, which was recorded as an addition to preferred stock dividends in 2024.
During 2024, the Corporation fully redeemed Series X, Series U, Series JJ and Series Z stock at their liquidation preference values for a total of $5.3 billion.

comparisons.peer_topic: Series E preferred stock dividend and redemption terms
comparisons.peer_summary: Series E preferred stock, issued as depositary shares, pays semiannual fixed dividends until May 15, 2025, followed by quarterly floating rate dividends, with dividends payable only when declared by the Board. Series V, related to this series, was redeemed in its entirety on January 30, 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs (GS) redeemed all outstanding shares of its Series K and Series P preferred stock in 2024. Citigroup (C) disclosed the redemption of its Series V preferred stock, though this occurred in early 2025 (January 30, 2025), which is chronologically close to the 2024 fiscal year but technically outside the 2024 calendar year redemption window described for GS. Both disclosures relate to the cessation of specific preferred stock series.

comparisons.comparison: Both GS and JPMorgan (JPM) executed significant redemptions of multiple preferred stock series during the 2024 fiscal year. Both firms utilized fixed-to-floating rate non-cumulative preferred stock structures for these redemptions.
